AvventuraNelCastelloJSEngine.dieText: I am deeply saddened by your untimely demise... Then again, it's always the best who go first (isn't it?). Take comfort, however, in the thought that:
instructions: Your main objective is to leave the castle alive.
To do so you will face many dangers and solve problems that will put your wits to the test.
In this adventure, I will be your alter ego—your eyes and ears—but you will make the decisions (and suffer the consequences).
To move, use:
- NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, WEST, UP, DOWN or simply:
- N, S, E, W, U, D
I will give you the full description of each location the first time you enter it, then only a short one. If you want the full description, tell me:
- LOOK or
- LOOK ROOM
Basic actions are:
- TAKE something
- DROP something
- LOOK something, e.g. LOOK AT THE STAIRCASE.
I'm not very clever, so use phrases like OPEN THE DOOR or JUMP and not elaborate ones like LOOK BEHIND THE SOFA or adverbs (LOOK CAREFULLY), which are beyond my understanding.
To act on an object, you usually need to possess it. Also remember that an action that has no effect in one place (e.g. SEARCH) may have an effect elsewhere.
Other important commands:
- WHERE reminds you where you are,
- WHAT lists the objects you carry,
- MOVES tells you how long you've played,
- POINTS tells you how much you've discovered,
- SAVE saves your situation to disk,
- LOAD restores your situation from disk,
- QUIT ends the game,
- INSTRUCTIONS repeats this description.
Good luck! (you'll need it)

armor.label: the armor
armor.description: Each suit of armor seems to look down on you with a haughty air.
armor.onTakeOrWear: Are you kidding? It weighs twice as much as you. In those days they weren't exactly softies, unlike today.

skeletons.label: the skeletons
skeletons.description: It's our common fate. Can't you think of something a bit more cheerful?

labyrinth.label: the labyrinth
labyrinth.description: Looks easy! In this blurred tangle of sloping planes along impossible curves, you can't tell floor from ceiling, and every direction looks the same.

fog.label: the fog
fog.description: It's hard to focus: you can't tell whether the uniform gray graininess you're staring at is ten meters away or ten centimeters from your nose. The howls that reach you are muffled, but no more reassuring for it.

crows.label: the crows
crows.description: They're completely invisible, lost somewhere in the uniform milky glow. You can only hear their harsh cawing coming from an indistinct point above your head.
crows.onListen: They caw their mockery at your useless, ridiculous efforts—or at least, that's the impression you get.

ramparts.label: the ramparts
ramparts.description: Looking down from the ramparts, the fog gives you a sort of vertigo. You can't see anything solid to gauge how high you are. But you can't be very high, judging by the spiral staircase you climbed to get up here.

spiralStaircase.description: You are in a room with a spiral staircase.

description: You are on the castle ramparts. Visibility is badly reduced by fog rising from the moor in broad, slow spirals. You hear—without seeing them—the cawing of crows circling above you.
A spiral staircase leads down.
ramparts.shortDescription: You are on the castle ramparts.
onJump: Thanks to your agility, you land without harm.
The wolves are delighted to have some fresh meat.

labyrinth.onDrop: It drifts away along winding paths in a twisted gravity.
labyrinth.onGetOut: Deluded! Do you think you can succeed where so many have failed?

help: You tune the onboard radio to the emergency frequency and send out an S.O.S.
For a few seconds, there's silence...
Then you clearly receive a recorded voice:
- We inform all air-rescue users that the service is temporarily suspended due to an unexpected staff strike.
In the meantime, please recite with me:
- Pater noster qui es in coelis...

verbs.land: I can't: the controls won't respond.

description: You are on the parade ground: a vast square of packed earth surrounded by high gray-stone walls.
In the middle of the esplanade, a massive stone slab covers the mouth of what used to be the castle well.
You hear, far away, wolves howling.
shortDescription: You are on the parade ground.

north.success: The gate slams shut heavily, leaving not even the tiniest crack.

directions.up: In case nobody ever taught you: a parachute is a device that only works on the way down.

drawbridge.label: a raised drawbridge
drawbridge.description: It's raised, but it can be lowered without much trouble.
drawbridge.onLower: The wolves come in and tear you to pieces.

stoneSlab.label: the stone slab
onLook: The stone slab, corroded by centuries, gives way under your weight. You plunge into the well, infested with slimy, repulsive

walls.description: They're massive, squared, and solidly built to withstand any assault.

description: You are in a vast atrium sunk in half-light. A gloomy phosphorescence oozing from the walls lets you make out the room's outlines.
A marble staircase climbs upward, vanishing into darkness softened only by a diffuse greenish glow.

directions.south: No chance. I'm afraid you'll have to find another way out.

blazon.label: a coat of arms painted on the ceiling
onLook: Suddenly, a trapdoor opens beneath your feet.

description: You are in the grand lounge, furnished with many sofas and comfortable armchairs. In the middle of one wall stands a monumental fireplace built from worked stone blocks.
Although the fire has been out for centuries, the room seems lit by a wavering reddish glow.

fireplace.description: It's so large you could easily crawl through it—if there were a passage. Pity there's no sign of one. Perhaps if you searched...

light.label: the light
light.description: Strange: when you look where you thought you saw the light, it seems to shift elsewhere. Perhaps it's only a reflection... or the centuries-old memory of blood spilled within these walls.

pass.onLookFor: There's absolutely no sign of secret passages in the fireplace. You read too many adventure books.

description: You are in a broad corridor. The floor bears the scars of countless generations passing through. Along the wall stands a row of suits of armor, each holding a long pike.
Near the middle of the corridor there seems to have been a door—now bricked up.

spades.label: the pikes
spades.description: Long, with a sharp iron tip—it looks deadly. How on earth was it used?

onTake.question: You grab the pike and pull it toward you, but the armor doesn't seem willing to let go. Should I insist
answer: With a determined yank, you finally manage to claim the pike.
The armor, thrown off balance, wobbles slightly...
and as you step back with the pike's tip clenched in your hands, the armor falls with all its weight onto the other end of the weapon, skewering you clean through.
So that's how it was used in battle!

door.description: I said it looks like there used to be a door. All that's left is the faint outline of its frame on the wall.

description: You are in the great dining hall, dominated end to end by an enormous oak table surrounded by many heavy, high-backed chairs.
Unlike every other room, the window is open.
diningRoom.shortDescription: You are in the dining hall.

down.question: Should I jump out the window

table.description: Solid and well built: it once served for Royal Banquets.

chairs.description: Looking at the chairs around the table, you picture the King and Queen seated gracefully at the ends, with guests arranged by rank, according to the rigid protocol of court ceremony.

window.label: the window
window.description: From the window you enjoy a magnificent view of the moat's murky waters, teeming with scaly monsters and razor teeth.
window.onJump: What do I look like, an idiot?

library.description: You are in the castle library. Its walls are entirely covered by shelves upon shelves, packed with books of every kind. In the center of the floor, in front of a comfortable armchair, stands a wrought-iron lectern.
library.HUGE: The weight of ancient wisdom is far greater than you ever suspected.

commands.lookForDictionary: I've examined all the shelves carefully, but I didn't find any dictionary.
iotid: The sound of the magic word echoes under the ancient vaults...
An entire wall of shelves rotates on itself. You glimpse a great hall.

shelves.description: A true Royal Library! It has everything—or almost. I'm convinced that with a proper search you could find anything in here.

books.label: the books
books.description: A true Royal Library! It has everything—or almost. I'm convinced that with a proper search you could find anything in here.
books.onTake: There are a few too many to carry around.
books.onRead: It would take centuries to leaf through them all. The ones you pick up are undoubtedly interesting, but they solve none of your problems. At least tell me what you're looking for.

label: a closed book on the lectern
a book on the lectern
book.description: It rests on the lectern and looks both ancient and brand-new.
book.onOpen: A scorched sheet slips out from the old yellowed pages.
book.onRead: It's a dictionary of ancient Gaelic.

dictionary.label: a dictionary
dictionary.description: It rests on the lectern and looks both ancient and brand-new.
dictionary.onRead: It's a list of Gaelic words, each with its translation (and a few notes) in modern language. The words are in alphabetical order, from A to Z. There's also a list of proverbs, idioms, and rules of grammar and pronunciation. Honestly—have you never seen a dictionary before?

wideTunnel.description: You are walking through a wide tunnel carved into the rock that forms the castle's foundations.
wideTunnel.shortDescription: You are in a wide tunnel.

north.fail: The ogre tears you to pieces.

castleDungeon.description: You are in the castle dungeon, once called "The Tomb". The floor is carpeted with skeletons.

hole.label: a hole in the wall
hole.description: It's narrow and deep: at the bottom there's something that looks like a button.

button.label: button
button.description: Staring at it won't help. Perhaps pressing it will...

slit.label: the slit
slit.description: It's in the west wall, and it's wide enough to squeeze through.

toolshed.description: You are in a small square room, once used to store tools.

directions.up: To climb up you must lift a stone slab, which falls back behind you.

narrowTunnel.description: You are in a narrow tunnel; its walls are covered with greenish mould and putrid mushrooms.
narrowTunnel.shortDescription: You are in a narrow tunnel.

moulds.label: the mould
moulds.description: They're fascinating, in their poisonous velvet fuzz.

mushrooms.label: the mushrooms
mushrooms.description: From what your limited expertise can tell, each one is more poisonous than the last.

longTunnel.description: You are in a long tunnel, carved partly into rock and partly into earth. The walls show traces of digging.
longTunnel.shortDescription: You are in a long tunnel.

excavations.label: the dig marks
excavations.description: Just attempts—clearly failed ones. Perhaps some castle prisoner making one last desperate try.

treasureChamber.description: You are in the treasure chamber—an immense hall upheld by mighty arches, set directly beneath the throne room.
treasureChamber.shortDescription: You are in the treasure chamber.

label: a heavy chest
an open heavy chest
onLook: Of Malcolm IV's fabulous Treasure, only an old horn remains.
onOpen: The ghost of Edgar mac Douglas, faithful squire to Sir Malcolm, rises to defend his ancient King's treasure from the foreign profaner.
The ghost wraps around you, suffocating you in its deadly embrace.

ghost.label: a ghost
ghost.description: You see it and you don't. At times it seems incorporeal—you can clearly make out the details of the wall behind it. But in other moments it seems to take on substance, growing ever more menacing.
ghost.onKill: It's been dead for seven hundred years.
onTalk: A distant dragging of metal objects (chains, perhaps?) seems to form a mournful reply:
- Remember that you came from Nothing, and to Nothing you must return...

woodshed.description: You are in the wood store, where dry branches and logs of various sizes are stacked in perfect order.

wood.label: the wood
wood.onTake: - Hey! Hands off my winter supplies! It's cold around here.

commands.helloPrefix: Though somewhat taken aback by your excessive familiarity...
introduceYourself: - Qfwfq, at your service. But your face doesn't seem entirely new to me. Haven't we met somewhere before?
You dutifully list your many honorary titles while the dwarf listens with an increasingly doubtful expression. Still...

askForDiamond: He already gave it to you, don't you remember?
I doubt he's willing to give it to you.

topOfStairs.description: You are at the top of the stairs. The steps end abruptly against a smooth stone wall.
topOfStairs.shortDescription: You are at the top of the stairs.

walls.description: I don't see any handholds or cracks.

description: You are at the entrance of the immense magical labyrinth. They say every passage leads to this single room, whose pull neither men nor things can escape.
On the ground lie two skeletons. On the wall, written in blood:
'Impossible to get out of here'
labyrinthEntrance.shortDescription: You are at the labyrinth entrance.

secretRoom.description: You are in the great secret room beneath the castle tower. A current of icy air whistles in through invisible cracks.
secretRoom.shortDescription: You are in the secret room.

label: an old stopped pendulum clock
an old pendulum clock
an old pendulum clock
an old pendulum clock
an old pendulum clock
an old pendulum clock
an old pendulum clock
description: It shows eleven fifty-six.
It shows eleven fifty-seven.
It shows eleven fifty-eight.
It shows eleven fifty-nine.
The hands are stuck at midnight.
onLook: A block of stone shifts, revealing a spiral staircase.

L29.dodgersHatch: This trapdoor is reserved for clever folks who claim they've made it here without translating the parchment...

throneRoom.description: You are in the ancient throne room, where the King once dispensed justice and received ambassadors. Along the sides of the hall are two rows of niches where the Sovereign's personal guards would stand. The imposing wooden throne is finely carved down to the smallest detail. Opposite the throne is a bricked-up doorway that must once have been the main entrance from the corridor.
throneRoom.shortDescription: You are in the throne room.

door.description: Obviously it's bricked up from this side too.

hollows.label: the niches
hollows.description: They're simple recesses in the wall. The King's personal guards must have had a rather boring job, if it consisted of standing there rigid all day long.

throne.label: the throne
throne.description: It dominates the room. Power sat upon it.

onSitDown.question: Do you want me to sit on the throne??
onSitDown.answer: The cushion isn't as comfy as I thought.

topOfTower.description: You are atop the tower, from where your gaze can roam above the fog that blankets the moor, all the way to the distant mountains.

fog.description: The surface of the fog is ruffled by waves in slow, perpetual motion, as if the tower were a floating island in this strange, fishless sea.

moor.label: the moor
moor.description: It's hidden beneath the fog, but at times, far away, it thins a little, letting you glimpse the barren yellowish land below.

mountains.label: the mountains
mountains.description: From the farthest snow-capped peaks, the mountains slope down through ridges, hills, gentle inclines, until they blend into the moor drowned in the sea of fog. You have the impression that something tiny moves around the summits, but it's probably just an optical illusion.

flag.label: a tattered flag
flag.description: Carried with glory in a hundred battles, it still flutters over lands it once ruled.
onTake: and suddenly gives way, making you lose your balance. You plunge into the parade ground.

tower.description: You can't tell how far it rises above the walls, because the fog reaches up with its insubstantial coils, sometimes making even your own feet vanish from sight.

undergroundSpiralStaircase.description: You are in a room with a spiral staircase and a narrow passage to the north.

aisle.description: It leads deeper into the castle's underground. Better go back, don't you think?

trap.description: You are in the trap room, which seems completely empty.
trap.shortDescription: You are in the trap room.

west: A massive iron slab suddenly drops, blocking every way out.
The room begins to fill with water... glug... glug... glug... glug... glug... glug... glug... glug... glug... glug... glug... glug... glug... glug... glug...

trap.label: the trap
trap.onLookOrLookFor: I don't see any trap at all. I don't understand why the room has such a curious name.

winePantry.description: You are in the pantry where wine used to be kept. On the shelves, only a few glass shards remain.
winePantry.shortDescription: You are in the wine pantry.

north: With that, he pulls a heavy axe from his belt and strikes you in a rage.

fragments.label: the shards
fragments.onTake: Besides the risk of cutting yourself badly, I can't see what use they'd be.

coldCutsPantry.description: You are in the pantry where cold cuts used to be stored. Only a few rusty hooks remain.
coldCutsPantry.shortDescription: You are in the cold-cuts pantry.

hooks.label: the hooks
hooks.onTake: Besides the risk of catching tetanus, I can't imagine what you'd do with them.

vegetablePantry.description: You are in the pantry where vegetables used to be kept. The only trace left is a few slimy greenish stains on the floor.
vegetablePantry.shortDescription: You are in the vegetable pantry.

cheesePantry.description: You are in the pantry where cheeses used to be kept. All that remains are a few rinds gnawed by mice.
cheesePantry.shortDescription: You are in the cheese pantry.

gamePantry.description: You are in the pantry where game used to be kept. All that remains is the shriveled carcass of an old deer.
gamePantry.shortDescription: You are in the game pantry.

deer.label: the deer
deer.onTake: Besides saddling yourself with extra weight, I can't see how it could be of any use.

whiskeyPantry.description: You are in the pantry where substantial stocks of the region's famous whisky were kept. All that remains is a little keg that looks extraordinarily well preserved.
whiskeyPantry.shortDescription: You are in the whisky pantry.

keg.label: the whisky keg
keg.description: It has a label: '700 yrs old'

guardRoom.description: The room you're in must have been the guard room that watched over the castle entrance. Aside from a crude table and some heavy benches, the room is completely bare.
guardRoom.shortDescription: You are in the guard room.

table.description: A rough wooden table—certainly not elegant, but very sturdy.

benches.label: the benches
benches.description: Made from the same wood as the table, smoothed by long use.

description: You are in an irregularly shaped room filled with bulky wooden and metal structures. They look like parts of an ancient war machine—probably a small catapult.
Heavy stone balls are lined up along the wall.
catapultRoom.shortDescription: You are in the catapult room.
commonAnswers: Who do you think you are—Hercules?
I was never very good with construction toys.

catapult.label: the catapult
catapult.description: It's been dismantled into many pieces to take up less space and keep it in better condition.

pieces.label: the pieces
pieces.description: They should be assembled to make the catapult—at least, I think so.

armory.description: You are in the castle armory. Fixed to the walls are bows, daggers, shields, spears, axes and other weapons—every one of them corroded and made useless by time.

weapons.description: As I said, they're all corroded and made useless by time.

understairs.description: You are in a small space under the stairs, completely empty.

servantsHall.description: In this room, where the King's servants once slept, there's absolutely nothing noteworthy.
servantsHall.shortDescription: You are in the servants' hall.

columnsHall.description: You are in a long hall whose sides are lined with two rows of tall columns supporting an arched ceiling. Though corroded by time, the columns still bear the marks of patient work by skilled craftsmen. In the center of the hall, a small stone column rests on a low pedestal.
columnsHall.shortDescription: You are in the hall of columns.

column.label: the column
column.description: On the capital, in shining silver letters, half of a powerful magic word is carved: 'ID'

columns.label: the columns
columns.description: The columns along the hall are rather austere in style: simple stone cylinders tapering toward the top.

pedestal.label: the pedestal
pedestal.description: The pedestal supporting the small column is a block of rough stone, probably granite.

tapestriesRoom.description: You are in a room whose walls are completely covered with exquisitely crafted tapestries. Most depict hunting scenes, but there are also battlefields and rustic scenes of country life. The colors are remarkably well preserved, despite the centuries.
tapestriesRoom.shortDescription: You are in the tapestries room.

tapestries.label: tapestries
onLook: They're made with great mastery and deserve closer attention. You lose yourself in contemplation...
Then, suddenly, you remember you have something more important to do.

description: You are in a long, unfurnished hall. Along the walls hang the portraits of the Kings and dignitaries who, over the centuries, ruled the castle and its fiefs.
The portraits seem to stare at you with malevolent eyes. One in particular—Malcolm IV—appears to follow your movements with a look full of mortal hatred.
portraitsGallery.shortDescription: You are in the portrait gallery.

portrait.label: the portrait
portrait.onLookQuestion: The painter's hand seems to have captured life itself from the subjects' faces—especially in Malcolm IV's case. There's something strange about this portrait. Should I look at it more closely

trophiesRoom.description: You are in a short hall literally crammed with hunting and war trophies. Mounted on the walls you see animals of every kind, weapons, shields— even an entire suit of armor that likely belonged to an enemy King slain in battle by the Sovereign himself.
trophiesRoom.shortDescription: You are in the trophies room.

onLook.template: It is the armor of Sir Crawdolf, the valiant warrior-mage who for many years kept King Malcolm in check with his prowess and terrible arts. The armor still carries itself proudly and seems to stare at you${spadeText}.

kitchen.description: The room you're in must have been the castle kitchen. You can see a large hearth and the remains of crockery, pots, and big tubs.

description: You are in the Alchemist's cell. All around are crucibles, mortars, alembics, and bizarre glass vessels in wildly twisted shapes. On the shelves lie many heavy in-folios of magic, alchemy, and spells. In the center stands a little table on three legs shaped like the paws of some monstrous beast. On the table, a single heavy volume bound in black leather:
"The Sorcerer's Apprentice"
alchemistCell.shortDescription: You are in the Alchemist's cell.

infolio.label: in-folio
infolio.description: The typical gear of an alchemist of the age: mage, scholar, and healer all at once. Alchemists were held in high regard—and greatly feared and respected—unless they fell from grace after some fatal mistake to the King's detriment.
infolio.onTakeOrRead: An occult force seems to warn you: rummaging through an alchemist's personal belongings can be very dangerous.

volume.label: the tome
volume.description: Now that you see it up close, you realize it might not be leather at all... but tanned human skin.
volume.onOpen: You must use the right tool.
onRead: You can read only a single word:
volume.onLiftUp: Lift the tome? Are you deaf??

boardRoom.description: You are in the council chamber, where the gravest and most important decisions were made. The only furniture is a round table surrounded by eight chairs.
boardRoom.shortDescription: You are in the council chamber.

description: On the table's edge a wise saying is engraved:
"Not all swords wound with their blade."

chairs.description: Here sat the King's noble knights, helping the Sovereign with difficult decisions on the conduct of endless wars.

wardrobe.description: You are in the King's wardrobe. Moths and woodworms have reduced the imposing wardrobes and refined garments to a few shreds and piles of sawdust.

description: You are in the music hall, where feasts, entertainments, and performances once brightened castle life.
Everything is now covered in cobwebs.
musicHall.shortDescription: You are in the music hall.

cobwebs.label: the cobwebs
cobwebs.description: Even the cobwebs are deserted now. Nothing remains of the life that once made this room the merriest place in the castle.

princessRoom.description: You are in the Princess's room. The passing years have left almost untouched the delicate colors of the drapes and the fragile canopy bed—missing only the softest duvet that once sweetened the slender girl's gentle sleep.
princessRoom.shortDescription: You are in the Princess's room.

bed.description: It's decorated in delicate, shaded hues.

curtains.label: the curtains
curtains.description:
Embroidered on the curtains in a thin gold thread:
"Wise is the one who destroys their wealth to take the paths of heaven"

kingRoom.description: You are in the King's bedchamber. A sumptuous canopy bed dominates the room, taking up most of it. Nothing else remains of the rich furnishings.
kingRoom.shortDescription: You are in the King's room.

bed.description: It's painted in strong, blood-red colors.

mirrorsHall.description: You are in a hall whose walls are covered with mirrors of every shape and size. Curved mirrors, giant mirrors, concave mirrors reflect your image endlessly, giving you the impression that malicious faces watch you from every corner. It was the vain Queen's favorite room.
mirrorsHall.shortDescription: You are in the hall of mirrors.
mirrorsHall.notADoor: That's not a door—it's a mirror!

commands.getOut: With all these mirrors I can't tell directions anymore. I always end up going the wrong way.

mirrors.label: the mirrors
mirrors.onBreak: I really don't feel like risking seven years of bad luck.

pass.description: You are in a dark, narrow, twisting passage. You're forced to crawl forward toward the glimmer of light that manages to seep in from the far end.
pass.shortDescription: You are in the twisting passage.

pass.description: So dark! You can't see a thing.

description: You are alone and abandoned on a black rock jutting out of icy waters.
Correction: you're not alone. The Loch Ness monster keeps you company (Nessie, to friends).

rock.label: the rock
description: It consists of a persilicic rock with an oligocrystalline granular structure, mostly medium-fine grained.
The fundamental crystalline aggregate is composed mainly of quartz and feldspars, with subordinate micaceous flakes.

Looking closely at the feldspars, you can note orthoclase (or microcline), albite and other sodic plagioclases. The micas are represented by biotite and muscovite, mixed with other mafic components—amphiboles in particular.
The structure also contains small crystals of apatite and zircon, as well as grains of magnetite and pyrite.

parachute.label: a parachute
parachute.onLook: Never seen a parachute? Where are you from?

onOpen.notHere: In here? Don't make me laugh!

label: a bone
a severed bone
bone.onLook: It might be a femur, or maybe a tibia. I don't know—I'm no anatomist.

onLookFor.dontHaveIt: The floor is full of them.
onLookFor.inYourHand: You've got one in your hand.

bludgeon.label: a spiked mace
bludgeon.description: A weapon of war. It can't smash a wall, but it can certainly come in handy.

label: a cat crouched on the floor
a cat

onTake.gotIt: The cat is hungry and lets you pick it up easily.

cat.onTalkOrGreet: The cat stares at you with interest, its slanted pupils reduced to two narrow slits; then it decides (probably) that your intelligence is merely apparent, and looks elsewhere.
onKill: With one last mournful meow, the poor kitty dies staring at you with a reproachful look.
The corpse grows more and more indistinct, until it vanishes completely.

finished: The cat really enjoyed the milk-and-honey.

label: a sword
an enchanted sword
sword.onLook: A spell is written on the blade.

spell.dontRemember: I can't remember it; it was too complicated.
spell.question: Should I say it aloud
fail: Your throat is dry with fear...
The ghost takes advantage to attack you.
spell.success: With a long, desperate wail, the ghost returns to the Nothing from which it came.

spell.label: the spell
spell.onLook: I think reading these strange symbols and formulas could awaken forces long asleep.

lute.label: a lute
lute.description: This instrument brightened dance feasts held for harvests, victories, ceremonies, and any excuse that could justify a dance feast.

harp.label: a harp
harp.description: This instrument accompanied the sad and joyful tales the castle bard would chant on long winter nights, while everyone gathered around, entranced by ancient legends.

bagpipe.label: a bagpipe
bagpipe.description: This instrument accompanied military expeditions led personally by the King, marking the soldiers' heavy marching step with its high, rhythmic wail.

fail: You deserve to be part of Edinburgh's Royal Band!
onPlay.success: The tome opens to the page marked by a decorated bookmark.

sheet.label: a scorched sheet
sheet.description: Though partially consumed by flames, it's still readable.

cushion.label: a cushion
cushion.description: Don't think about sleeping—think about getting out of here.

case.label: a case
case.description: The case's wood is inlaid with great care.
case.onTake: It's screwed to the throne seat.
case.onSkrewOff: You don't have the right tool.
case.onOpen: The case contains an old parchment.

scroll.label: a parchment
scroll.description: Time has faded it, but it's still easy to read.

onRead.fail: I'm sorry—it's written in a language I don't know.

onTranslate.fail: How am I supposed to do that without a dictionary?
success: "Only with wisdom can you find the exit of the labyrinth"

ogre.label: a fierce ogre with sharp tusks
onLook: On closer inspection, it doesn't seem all that fierce...

label: a small dwarf with a big diamond
a very friendly little dwarf

onGreet.withoutDiamond: - Good evening to you! - replies the dwarf.
onGreet.withDiamond: The dwarf is so happy to finally meet a polite person that he gives you the diamond.

onKill: The dwarf, lightning-fast, draws a sharp dagger and strikes you hard, exclaiming:
- Is it possible that only thieves and assassins pass through here?! -

diamond.label: a diamond
diamond.description: The more you gaze at the marvelous gem, the more an unbridled craving to possess it grows within you.

onBreak.success: At the first blow of the mace, the diamond shatters into a thousand pieces.

diamond.onLook: It's magnificent: light reflected and refracted through a thousand perfect facets builds endless plays of color. You're fascinated and could stare for hours. I think it's priceless—and that you'd better treat it with the utmost care.

key.label: a small crystal key
key.description: It's very strange: too small to be a door key, and it seems fragile too. What could it possibly be for?

horn.label: a horn
horn.description: It's decorated with hunting scenes that spiral outward from the mouthpiece. Knights at a gallop chase their prey while great birds circle above their heads.
horn.onPlay: A cavernous sound echoes through the castle walls.

prologue: The ancient Scottish legends speak of heroic deeds and the dark sorceries of the old Kings.
They also speak of fabulous treasures, never found.
Your burning adventurous spirit—driven by thirst for glory and hunger for riches—doesn't hesitate a moment:
you rent a small tourist plane and set off on your Great Adventure!
intro: You are piloting your single-seater over the desolate Scottish Highlands. You have just flown over Loch Ness...
parachute: Well look at that. There's a parachute. I truly hadn't seen it.
I promise that from now on I'll be more careful and will scrupulously report every object present.
Anyway, I've put it on now.
jumpFromPlane: the plane crashes to the ground as the parachute opens.
You drift down gently in the dying light of day. Beneath you lies a desolate moor. The wind pushes you toward a crumbling castle. You touch down in the castle's great parade ground.
While you fold the parachute you look around:

arm.question: Should I stick my arm in the hole
answer: A blade snaps down, cleanly cutting off your arm.
While you bleed to death, let me just say you're behaving rather imprudently.

success: A blade snaps down, cleanly cutting through the bone.

portrait: The moment you fix your eyes on Malcolm IV's portrait, you feel inexorably drawn by his magnetic gaze. You cannot break the line connecting your eyes to the painting's, and you find yourself, against your will, moving closer and closer to the canvas. An invisible hand seems to clamp your throat in a steel vise, while a mocking smile forms on the King's face, depicted in sumptuous ceremonial attire.
When you feel you're at your limit, the hand from the abyss of time suddenly releases its deadly grip.
You collapse to the floor and lose consciousness as everything spins around you. You can't see it, but an expression of satisfaction has appeared on Malcolm IV's face.
eat: First you get a terrible stomachache...
you believe you have finally understood all universal truths...
but in the end you are left with nothing but a heavy band around your head.
eagle: The sound of the ancient horn races across the moor, echoing all the way to the distant mountains.
A black dot detaches from the mountains and grows as it approaches.
It swiftly reaches the tower: a great Royal Eagle dives toward you with outstretched talons.
the Eagle grabs you, lifting you rapidly to a great height.
Suddenly, the Eagle lets go of you.
rock: You drift down gently in the light of the rising day. Beneath you are the dark waters of Loch Ness. The wind pushes you toward the center of the lake. You land luckily on a small rocky outcrop.
While you fold the parachute you look around:

string: Is it possible you managed to forget it again

final: The sound of the ancient horn races across the moor, echoing all the way to the distant mountains.
A black dot detaches from the mountains and grows as it approaches.
It swiftly reaches the rock: a helicopter from the Royal Archaeological Service throws you a rescue ladder. You climb as the monster's jaws snap shut on empty air just centimeters below you.
As the helicopter heads toward Edinburgh, you tell your adventure, showing the horn—the only object you managed to keep. Seeing it, Prof. Mac Anthrop (director of the Edinburgh museum) exclaims:
- But this is Malcolm IV's horn, believed lost forever!
- It's worth at least a million pounds! - declares his assistant.
The helicopter lands in Edinburgh.
You are immediately arrested for:
- Obstructing public land with airplane wreckage.
- Violating Royal residence.
- Theft of beverages (with swallowing).
- Mistreatment of a cat of noble lineage.
- Smuggling archaeological artifacts.
- Harassing a state-owned ghost.
- Illegal carrying of a bladed weapon.
- Disorderly drunkenness.
- Practicing sorcery without a license.
- Disturbing a protected-species monster.
The horn is, naturally, confiscated to be entrusted to the museum.
The director, still excited by the important discovery, intervenes in your favor. You are released, and you are even awarded a prize by grateful Scots (rather unusual):
A
FREE
ticket for a tourist trip on Loch Ness! -
Still, take comfort: you have finally reached
points and the right to bear the coveted title of:
LIEUTENANT OF THE DEVIL!!!
See you at the next adventure!

plane: The fuselage is filled with smoke.
nessie: I see the Loch Ness monster approaching.
I see the Loch Ness monster approaching too close.
